- `distance_metric`: the dispatch measures first whether the installed spec's vector field shape carries **any** metric-spelling key (an equivalent under a different name). **Equivalent exists** ⇒ align/rename to the spec's spelling (mechanical). **None exists** ⇒ delete it too, same tombstone treatment — with zero measured readers/writers, removal takes no capability away, and keeping a consumer-side declaration the producer refuses is the exact AI-author trap #4644/#4675/#4679 closed (the third option, extending the spec, has no measured pull to justify it and would be a maintainer call — not taken unasked).
- Either way: one PR, `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` + changeset, mirroring PR #4686; the deletion-class ACCEPT re-verifies the reference face independently.
